'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2024 Beersheba bus station shooting]]
***A [[Israel Police|police officer]] is killed and thirteen other people are injured in [[Beersheba]], [[Israel]], in an incident described as a terrorist attack. The perpetrator is shot dead by security forces. [https://m.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-823371 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] 
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 26 people are killed in Israeli [[airstrike]]s allegedly targeting [[Hamas]] militants that hit a [[mosque]] and a school housing displaced [[Palestinians]] in [[Deir al-Balah]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0jwv16qwqjo (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[Hezbollah]] claims that its attacks on [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldiers]] trying to infiltrate [[Blida, Lebanon|Blida]], [[Lebanon]], forced the soldiers to retreat. [https://www.barrons.com/news/hezbollah-says-repelled-attempted-israeli-infiltration-at-border-village-d47c025a (AFP via Barron's)]
***The [[Israeli military]] establishes a [[forward operating base]] near a [[UNIFIL|United Nations peacekeeping force in Lebanon]], putting [[UN peacekeeping|peacekeepers]] at risk. UNIFIL has refused the Israeli military's request to move its positions. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/7/israel-steps-up-lebanon-bombing-as-hezbollah-attacks-haifa (Al Jazeera)]
**A rocket fired from Lebanon strikes a restaurant in [[Haifa]], [[Israel]], injuring at least six people. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-823452 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Insurgency in Sindh]]
**[[2024 Karachi Airport bombing]]
***At least two people, both [[Chinese people|Chinese]] nationals, are killed and ten others are injured when an oil tanker truck exploded near [[Jinnah International Airport]] in [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]]. The separatist group [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] claims responsibility for the explosion, stating they targeted a convoy of Chinese workers of the Port Qasim Electric Power Company. [https://crisis24.garda.com/alerts/2024/10/pakistan-baloch-liberation-army-claims-oct-6-attack-near-karachis-jinnah-international-airport-that-killed-two-chinese-nationals-update-1 (Crisis24)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-one-dead-10-injured-explosion-near-karachi-airport-geo-news-says-2024-10-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Lusikisiki shootings#Aftermath|2024 Godini shooting]]
**Six people are killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] after eight gunmen open fire on a group of community patrollers in Godini village near [[Qumbu]], [[Eastern Cape]], [[South Africa]]. The shooting took place on the day of the memorial service for the victims of the [[2024 Lusikisiki shootings|Lusikisiki shootings]], which also occurred in the Eastern Cape. [https://www.news24.com/news24/southafrica/news/six-people-killed-four-injured-in-another-eastern-cape-mass-shooting-20241007 (News24)]
